sloka: अवलीनः स निर्वाक्यो हनुमाञ्शिंशपाद्रुमे ।सीतां सन्तर्जयन्तीस्ता राक्षसीरशृणोत्कपिः ।। ५.२२.९।।।।
transliteration: avalīnaḥ sa nirvākyo hanumāñśiṁśapādrume ।sītāṁ santarjayantīstā rākṣasīraśṛṇotkapiḥ ।। 5.22.9।।।।

translations.english: "If you are still reluctant to accept me as your husband after two months you will be sent to kitchen to be cooked as morning breakfast for me".
